column1: # Device button bit -> record flag bit, MEASURED by execution, cycle 1321.
# tools/audit_input_button_map_microexec.py runs 0x821CAA50 once per device bit
# with that bit alone set, plus a null control. 101 cases, one Ghidra startup.
# The consumer does NOT copy the button word: bit 12 in gives bit 5 out. The
# thirteen or/stw pairs at 0x821CABE0..0x821CAC4C are where the remap lives, and
# this table is what they do rather than what they look like.
# The XInput column is the standard XINPUT_GAMEPAD_* assignment for that bit
# position. It is a LABEL, not a measurement -- the run set a bit, not a button.
# Read from the 0x00 poison pass. The flag word is accumulated with lwz/or/stw,
# so the 0xCD pass hides every mask bit 0xCD already carries. The 0x00 pass is
# also the real precondition: the frame stage clears +0x00..+0x83 first.
# columns: device_bit xinput_label record_flag_bit
# NEGATIVES, each with a working positive control in the same batch -- the
# fourteen rows above lit up in the same run, so a blank result here is the
# absence of an effect and not a broken experiment:
#   held bits 10 and 11        no record bit. XInput leaves both unassigned.
#   held bits 16..31           no record bit. The device word is 32 bits wide and
#                              only its low 16 reach a record.
#   pressed, all 32 bits       no record bit. The edge words at device+0x14 and
#   released, all 32 bits      +0x18 are NOT folded into the record flag word.
#   device+0x38, device+0x3A   no record bit. Cycle 1318 could not place these
#                              two halfwords and they do not reach the flag word.
#   device+0x4A, device+0x4B   no record bit. CYCLE 1318 GUESSED THE TRIGGERS FED
#                              record bits 14 and 15. That guess is refuted; both
#                              lie beyond device+0x43 and outside the snapshot
#                              copy, and driving them to 0xFF changes nothing.
# So record flag bits 14 and 15 remain unexplained, with four candidates now
# eliminated by execution rather than left standing as a guess.
# AND NO AXIS BIT APPEARS IN THIS WORD. A run with LY at 30000 fills the float
# slot at +0x50 and leaves the flag word at 0x00000020 -- bit 17 is NOT set. The
# masks 0x10000..0x80000 cycle 1318 paired with the axes select a slot; they are
# not written into the record's flag word.
